officialJapaneseCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (Japanese)
officialJapaneseCatalog.evidence: Official 26/27 catalog linked from GRAY's January 15, 2026 catalog announcement. Confirms Type-R model, 11 size/width variants, per-size dimensions, stance data, base, edge specification, stiffness references, two Japanese MSRP tiers, directional/triple-radius/negative/Vario Camber design, and X-shaped 0.4 mm Titanal construction.

officialEnglishCatalog.title: 2026-2027 GRAY SNOWBOARDS PERFECT GUIDE (English)
officialEnglishCatalog.evidence: Season-specific corroboration for the product description and construction diagram (sintered top sheet, Titanal plate, wood core, fiberglass, steel edge, running base). The English machine-extracted size header duplicates IIIw and some feature bullets conflict with the per-size Japanese table; use the Japanese table for variant labels and dimensions.

officialCatalogAnnouncement.evidence: Official announcement published 2026-01-15 linking the Japanese and English 26/27 catalog PDFs.

officialSeasonTechnology.evidence: 26/27 season-specific technology page says Type-R has X-shaped 0.4 mm Titanal under the topsheet, sintered top sheet, and 48-hardness steel edges.

officialSeasonProduct.evidence: Confirms the 26/27 Type-R identity, high-speed carving role, tapered hammerhead shape, Vario Camber, multi-radius sidecut and 0.4 mm X-shaped titanium construction.

officialJapan.note: Not a verified China-market offer or Chinese retail price.

seedNormalization.note: Currency normalization only; not a Chinese-market price.

units.overallLengthMm: Printed in millimeters; represented in YAML as millimeters and overall size in centimeters.
units.sidecutRadiusMm: Catalog prints three radii in millimeters; YAML preserves sequence and converts to meters without assigning a curve segment beyond catalog order.
units.boardWidthsLengthsMm: Nose/tail widths and nose/tail lengths are in millimeters.
units.stanceSetbackMm: Catalog printed value in millimeters; direction/sign convention is not explained, so the numeric magnitude is preserved as printed.
units.stiffness: Catalog N/W/T positions preserved as manufacturer scale text; not normalized into the site's flex field.

conflictsAndLimits: The Japanese catalog size-table edge row prints 1.8mm/45RCW, while its season model-feature text says 48 Rockwell; the season-specific official technology page also says hardness 48. Preserve the conflict; do not silently choose one value.
The PDF does not explain the sign/direction convention for stance setback; raw magnitudes are retained, without asserting direction.

No independent 26/27 production-sample ride test was located in this pass. The existing six editorial scores are retained as low-confidence structure/positioning estimates; external scores are not mapped.

No verified Chinese-market sale price, product weight, warranty term, image reuse permission, or size-specific explicit core/fiberglass layup was found. Do not infer these from Japanese MSRP or general construction graphics.

scoringReview.decision: Keep numerical scores unchanged. Official materials substantiate a premium high-speed carving role but are insufficient to verify snow performance by dimension. Mark all scores low confidence, especially float/park/forgiveness, and mark value low confidence because the displayed CNY is a currency conversion, not a China retail offer.
scoringReview.confidence: low; no same-season independent ride test found

mappingNotes: Japanese catalog provides unambiguous variants: IIIn, III, IIIw, IV, IVw, Vw, Vew, VI, VIew, VII, VIIew. The English PDF's extracted header duplicates IIIw; Japanese version controls labels.
Representative seed fields use Vew 167, but the full 11-row catalog table is retained so no size variant is hidden.
Manufacturer stiffness N/W/T values are preserved as text and not mapped to the site's 0-10 flex score.
The size table's 1.8mm/45RCW row conflicts with same-season official 48 RC narrative/technology claims; per-size YAML records both claims explicitly.
The official 26/27 English product page image URL remains reference-only; no license for local hosting/republication was confirmed.
imageRights: No explicit reuse license verified; retain as verification reference only and do not copy to hosted production assets without permission or original photography.
